mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sla_timer (ticket_id, timer_type, deadline, state, escalated) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{timerType}, #{deadline}, #{state}, 0)

INSERT INTO sla_timer (ticket_id, timer_type, deadline, state, escalated) VALUES
(#{it.ticketId}, #{it.timerType}, #{it.deadline}, #{it.state}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, ticket_id, timer_type, deadline, state, breached_at, escalated, create_time, update_time FROM sla_timer WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, ticket_id, timer_type, deadline, state, breached_at, escalated, create_time, update_time FROM sla_timer WHERE state != 'breached' ORDER BY deadline ASC
SELECT id, ticket_id, timer_type, deadline, state, breached_at, escalated, create_time, update_time FROM sla_timer WHERE state = 'breached' AND escalated = 0 ORDER BY breached_at ASC LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE sla_timer SET state = #{state}, breached_at = #{breachedAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sla_timer SET escalated = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND escalated = 0
